name: Haramura Seizou
source:
Age 52. He is a well-known psychologist and author, a former university professor. Although his writings are academic in nature, they are popular for their humor and appropriate sting, making them easy to read. His books have been bestsellers without exception, and he is constantly receiving offers from many publishers, but he has taken a break from serious writing for the past two years.  On the other hand, he is disliked by fellow experts for pandering to the public too much.

He is a large, middle-aged man with a protruding belly, well-dressed at best, metabolic at worst. His hairline has receded to nearly the top of his head, and he wears glasses. His limbs are surprisingly strong, and he can perform various positions without difficulty. He has a huge cock and is a voracious sleazebag.

In his writings and on social networking services, he repeatedly asserts that “sexual harassment is a form of communication,” and he is recognized by the public as a representative of "old men with Showa-era values." He is often arrogant and insensitive, but in fact he has excellent powers of observation and is good at detecting people's inner feelings from their facial expressions and tone of voice.
